The <b>Magnetite Dice</b> are a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It has a chance to block damage when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is hit by an enemy or moving hazards, as well as boosting Hornet's luck in several niche situations.

== Usefulness ==
The dice have a variable chance to block a single hit of damage from an enemy or moving hazard - stationary hazards that cause Hornet to respawn on safe ground when hit cannot be blocked. Hornet will still be knocked back during the hit, so caution is advised when using it near environmental hazards.

The block chance resets to 0% every time the Tool prevents damage and increases by 2.02% with each hit taken, up to a maximum of 10.1%. This gives the following block chances for each hit:

{| class="article-table" style="text-align: center; width: 100%;"
! 0 Hits Taken
! 1 Hit Taken
! 2 Hits Taken
! 3 Hits Taken
! 4 Hits Taken
! 5+ Hits Taken
|-
|0%
|2.02% <math>\left(\frac{2}{99}\right)</math>
|4.04% <math>\left(\frac{4}{99}\right)</math>
|6.06% <math>\left(\frac{6}{99}\right)</math>
|8.08% <math>\left(\frac{8}{99}\right)</math>
|10.1% <math>\left(\frac{10}{99}\right)</math>
|-
|}

The average block chance is 7.7878%.

The dice are only able to block the last hit of multihit attacks ({{Damage|1+1}} or {{Damage|1+1+1}}), only reducing the damage of these attacks by one mask. They also cannot block damage from being eaten by [[Groal the Great]], [[Barnak]]s, or [[Gloomsac]]s.<ref group=Source>All of these use <code>HeroController.DoSpecialDamage()</code> to deal damage, which does not trigger the dice.</ref> Attacks that deal {{Damage|2}} in a single hit will be fully blocked by the dice, making them more effective against these attacks.

The Magnetite Dice are one of the only Yellow Tools to provide an advantage in combat. This means they can be added onto any combat build at effectively no cost, making them worth using in most combat situations despite the unreliable luck based effect.

The Magnetite Dice also give a small boost to a couple of luck-based events:
* The chance of landing a critical hit with the [[Wanderer Crest]] is raised from 2% to 2.2%
* The drop rate of [[Silver Bells]] is increased from 25% to 30%

== How to Acquire ==
* Prior to defeating the [[Cogwork Dancers]] or obtaining the [[Clawline]]: Given by [[Lumble the Lucky]] if you win against him after he runs out of [[Rosaries]].
* After defeating the Cogwork Dancers or obtaining the Clawline: Found next to Lumble's body.
* [[Act 3]]: Sold by [[Grindle]] for {{R|300}}.

== Trivia ==
*The Magnetite Dice are made up of 3 different sided dice, those being a D4 (Tetrahedron), D8 (Octahedron), and a non-standard D14 (Hexagonal Bifrustum).
* Magnetite is the name of a [[wikipedia:Magnetite|real-world mineral]] that is ferrimagnetic, meaning it is attracted to magnets and can become magnetic itself. Naturally-magnetic magnetite, traditionally called lodestone, was the source of the original discovery of magnetism.
